title: FormFillingOverride

skip_welcome_page.description: Override the global skip_welcome_page for this form. Null = inherit.

hide_finalize_checkbox.description: Override the global hide_finalize_checkbox for this form. Null = inherit.

hide_instance_name.description: Override the global hide_instance_name for this form. Null = inherit.

pinned_forms.description: Override the global pinned_forms while this form is being filled. Null (or omitted) inherits the global list; an empty list explicitly shows no pinned forms for this form.

post_submit_form_id.description: Override the global post_submit_form_id for this form. Must be a valid SurveyCTO form ID. Null = inherit.

post_submit_url.description: Override the global post_submit_url for this form. Either a relative path starting with '/' or an absolute https URL, which may point outside this server. Null = inherit.

auto_send.description: Override the global auto_send for this form. Null = inherit.

description: Per-form override of form_filling_config settings. All fields are nullable: null (or omitted) means "inherit the global default".
